Asha: monthly recurrence check-in 1: top recurring themes in the last 4 weeks: GPU OOMs during long inferences, intermittent cache-key collisions, and spikes in control-plane API 429s. want explicit owners + short remediation steps.

Ben: I can take GPU OOMs. immediate plan: clamp max_batch_size per-model, enable early OOM guard, and add nightly memory-snapshot job for critical pools. ETA: PR by Thu, canary Fri.

Kai: I'll own cache-key collisions. suspect inconsistent client encodings + new route aliases. short fixes: add deterministic key-normalizer, retro run a repair job for existing keys, and alert on collision rate > 0.1%. ETA: design tomorrow, INF-4410 ticket.

Ruth: 429 spikes look like control-plane autoscale + bursty API clients. short-term: add a token bucket limiter per-route and backoff headers to clients. long-term: scale controller horizontally and add queueing. I'll draft a runbook and open INF-4411. ETA: runbook Mon.

ops-bot: Tracker entry created: REC-2026-05 (link: https://redwood.internal/ops/rec/REC-2026-05)

Asha: please add clear acceptance criteria: GPU OOMs = zero OOM restarts for 14d in canary; cache collisions = collision-rate < 0.05% for 14d; control-plane 429s = p99 < 1% 429s for 7d.

Ben: INF-4412 created for memory-snapshots + guard. added ACs.

Kai: INF-4410 created for key-normalizer and repair job. added unit tests AC.

Ruth: INF-4411 created for control-plane limits + runbook. added dashboard panel for 429s.

Asha: scheduling a 20m sync next Wed 09:00 to confirm canary results. calendar invite to follow. ping this thread when PRs are merged.

Ben: noted, will post perf deltas.

Kai: will include before/after collision metrics.

Ruth: will post runbook link and canary dashboard.

Asha: closing for now  reopen if blockers appear.
